text:
elaine (PM): quick sync — we need a concrete proposal for token accounting + rate limits that maps directly to pricing. goal: API v2 launch must expose fields that let customers reason about per-route spend and let billing reconcile invoices. thoughts? :sparkles:
sam (eng): do we want per-route limits (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank/tool) or per-model? they have different perf/cost profiles. also streaming vs final token counting matters.
raj (billing): prefer per-route + per-unit billing. embeddings billed per vector unit, generation billed per token. we need deterministic fields in responses so billing can reconcile: e.g. `x-tokens-request`, `x-tokens-response`, `billing_token_units`. :thumbsup:
marie (legal): reminder — any metering logs that include tokenized content must be scrubbed. retention + access controls required before we show detailed per-token breakdown to customers.
sam (eng): rough API/header sketch:```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-tokens-request: 42
x-tokens-response: 128
x-billing-units: gen=170;embed=0
x-rate-limit-remaining: 115
```
also include a `usage` object in final JSON for tooling clients. streaming: emit `delta_tokens` events in SSE with a running `streamed_tokens` counter.
raj (billing): streaming counters are fine but final invoice should use `billing_token_units` computed server-side. we can't rely on clients to sum SSE events.
amanda (cs): +1 on per-route quotas. two enterprise accounts asked to cap "llm_conversation" route to a low RPS and per-day token budget. they'll buy Dedicated if we offer predictable caps. :eyes:
sam (eng): proposed MVP scope: 1) headers + final `billing_token_units` in responses, 2) soft per-route quotas (alerts & throttling with 429), 3) separate buckets for embeddings vs gen. leave admin UI controls and hard reservation for next milestone.
elaine (PM): launch criteria suggestion: a) server-side billing_token_units present for all endpoints, b) per-route soft-limits enforceable with 429 + clear retry header, c) token metering accuracy within 1% in production tests, d) legal signoff on retention policy. agree/disagree?
raj (billing): agree but insist invoice-ready naming. call the field `x-billing-token-units` and include `billing_units_breakdown` in JSON for reconciliation.
marie (legal): will review retention draft. need opt-out for detailed usage export for customers in sensitive sectors.
devops-bot: deploy pipeline note — rate-limiter service v0.3 staged in canary, default per-route soft-limit = 100 rps, token-accounting lib v2.1 included.
elainE (PM): small typo above (me). action items: 1) sam — create API spec PR with header + JSON examples by EOD Wed (owner: sam). 2) raj — define mapping from tokens -> billing_units (including embeddings conversion) by Fri (owner: raj). 3) marie — retention & export policy draft by next Tue. 4) amanda — gather customer priority list for per-route caps (owner: amanda) by Thu. 5) eng — add streaming `delta_tokens` SSE event spec in PR. i'll schedule a 30m review on Thu. please ack. :white_check_mark:
